semiconductor_relevance: High — PRESYS Co., Ltd. is directly involved in the semiconductor value chain through its development and manufacturing of vacuum valves for semiconductor processes.
summary: PRESYS Co., Ltd. specializes in the development and manufacturing of high-quality vacuum valves tailored for semiconductor and display processes. The company is recognized for its advanced high vacuum technologies, which enhance chemical, heat, and vibration resistance, thereby improving operational efficiency and customer satisfaction.

Enhanced chemical, heat, and vibration resistance
